Velista: mapping a shop, and the map shoppers see

Somebody with the mapping permission walks a shop with the camera, marks sections, counters and notes, taps suggested shelves to fill them and edits any area by hand. A shop has several walks with a history each, and one walk is the map every shopper sees, from the basket or from the shop's own page. Plans velista 0121 to 0123 and 0126, and 0128 last for the drawn assets, backend 0168, 0175 and 0176, and the shop map libraries. Day and Night. Generated from the committed *.dc.html artboards and the notes in canvas.json.

Scale

THE BRIEF, in the user's words, over five rounds on 2026-09-29. A live grid that fills as you walk and mark, with the camera. Shelves are suggestions you tap to fill, at most 2 m wide. Marks are Section, Counter and Note, with the direction the phone faced. A section runs until you turn, mark another or press Section left, and walking back removes it. Shapes are saved in metres and the grid only helps drawing. A shop has several walks, one is shown to shoppers, and every walk keeps a history you can rewind. Shoppers see a friendly map with no grid, opened from the basket or from a shop's own page. Only accounts with the mapping permission see the walks.
